_doc: Self-healing capture recipes for webpage-capture.mjs. When a page captures thin or wrong, record a per-site fix here once; every future capture of that host auto-applies it. Key by exact host (docs.python.org) or host brand (python) — exact wins. All recipe fields are optional. See references/webpage-capture.md §7.

<host-or-brand>.note: why this recipe exists (what was broken) — for the next human
<host-or-brand>.contentSelector: CSS selector for the content root, overriding the default main/article/[role=main]
removeSelectors: extra CSS selectors to prune, e.g. .newsletter, .related-posts
keepSelectors: base-prune tags to spare when the site puts content in them, e.g. button for accordion guides
clickSelectors: CSS selectors — the FIRST match of each is clicked before extraction, e.g. #accept-cookies (cookie/consent walls)
<host-or-brand>.expandAll: true to force every <details> element open before extracting (reveals native click-to-expand content)
expandSelectors: CSS selectors — ALL matches of each are clicked before extraction, e.g. .show-more (expand-all buttons / ARIA accordions)
<host-or-brand>.waitForSelector: CSS selector to wait for before extracting (late SPA render)
<host-or-brand>.scrollToBottom: true to scroll to the page bottom before extracting (lazy-load)
<host-or-brand>.wait: settle seconds after load (number) — overrides the static/1.5s default

ona.note: No <main>; the guide body is the first <article> (~13k chars), and its sections sit inside <button> accordions — so keep buttons. The default main/article/[role=main] selector matched a small early node first (~1.9k).
